author: Scott Manley
description:
I've often compared events like explosions based upon the energy released, this is a convenient shorthand for putting the size into perspective, but it's only a very rough comparison. The actual effects for an event with the same energy vary dramatically based upon the way the energy is released, and I wanted to clear this up.

title: Comparing the Biggest Explosions - Conventional vs Nuclear vs Accidents
